SELECT post_id, user_id, title, content, thumbnail_image, category, country, view_count, like_count, comment_count, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, user_user_id, user_email, user_name, user_nickname, user_profile_img FROM ( SELECT p.post_id, p.user_id, p.title, p.content, p.thumbnail_image, p.category, p.country, p.view_count, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.deleted_at,
u.user_id as user_user_id, u.email as user_email, u.name as user_name, u.nickname as user_nickname, u.profile_img as user_profile_img,
